reproduce.command: git clone https://github.com/agentrambench/bench && cd bench && ./setup.sh && python3 hb.py quick && python3 export.py

llm: local deterministic mock (Anthropic Messages / OpenAI Responses / Gemini generateContent); no real model

harnesses.name: Codex CLI
harnesses.non_default_flags: custom model_provider (base_url, env_key, wire_api=responses); sandbox_mode=workspace-write; projects trusted; exec --skip-git-repo-check

harnesses.name: Crush
harnesses.non_default_flags: crushrc: provider add (type messages, base-url, dummy key) + model add; -y (yolo); -m model; XDG_RUNTIME_DIR private; project-init dialog pre-dismissed (.crush/init); Go binary run directly, not the npm node wrapper
harnesses.note: measured as the Go binary (the npm package adds a Node wrapper process)

harnesses.name: Goose
harnesses.non_default_flags: GOOSE_PROVIDER=anthropic, GOOSE_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_HOST+ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOSE_DISABLE_KEYRING=1, GOOSE_MODE=auto; telemetry consent pre-answered with its default (yes)
harnesses.note: line-based interactive CLI, not full-screen; its developer tools run in-process (no separate MCP process observed in 1.59.1)

harnesses.name: Gemini CLI
harnesses.note: Gemini API format (streamGenerateContent); usage statistics left at default (on) and counted as non-model traffic; model router left at default

harnesses.name: Cursor CLI
harnesses.reason: requires a Cursor account; model traffic goes through Cursor's backend, a local endpoint is unreachable

harnesses.name: Amp
harnesses.reason: model traffic goes only through Amp's backend (no local base-URL override)

harnesses.name: Warp
harnesses.reason: agent runs against Warp's cloud backend (no local base-URL override)

harnesses.name: Kiro / Amazon Q CLI
harnesses.reason: model traffic goes only through the AWS-hosted backend (no local base-URL override)

metrics.label: Private RAM, one agent doing the fixed task (peak)
metrics.note: max over 4 Hz samples of cgroup memory.stat anon (private, not shared, no page cache), harness + its tool processes

metrics.label: RSS peak, fixed task (includes shared pages)
metrics.note: sum of RSS over the harness processes; counts shared library pages in full

metrics.label: CPU time for the fixed task
metrics.note: cgroup cpu.stat usage_usec for the whole run

metrics.label: Start-up: launch to first model request
Private RAM per agent at the end of the idle hold (incl. terminal)
metrics.note: cgroup anon at the end of the hold / N, for the (N, hold_s) of the row; median over runs of that cell; TUIs in one tmux (counted); each agent first read ~320 KB of tool output

metrics.label: CPU per idle agent per hour
metrics.note: cgroup CPU consumed during the hold / N / hours

metrics.label: Non-model network upload per idle agent per hour (lower bound)
metrics.note: bytes sent on non-loopback TCP sockets during the hold, ss sampling every 2 s (lower bound)

metrics.label: On-disk state + caches for the whole fleet
First model request size (system prompt + tools)
metrics.note: bytes of the first model request body

metrics.label: Estimated uncached input tokens for the fixed task (bytes/4, ideal prefix cache)
metrics.note: request bytes / 4 minus an idealized prefix cache (1 KiB granularity); estimate, not a tokenizer

metrics.label: Model requests for the fixed task (incl. auxiliary)
Non-model network upload during the fixed task (lower bound)
Planted secrets (.env, ~/.aws, env var) found in model requests
metrics.note: count of requests containing a planted secret string

metrics.label: Idle agents per GiB of RAM (private RAM)
metrics.note: 1024 / idle private MiB per agent (terminal included); rank only results with comparable=true (same N and hold for every harness, see fleet_comparable)

metrics.label: Private RAM per agent right after its work turn (incl. terminal)
metrics.note: cgroup anon / N right after every agent's work turn (20 x 16 KB tool outputs + ~3 KB streamed markdown report)

metrics.label: Private RAM per agent 5 min after work (incl. terminal)
Private RAM per agent 60 min after work (incl. terminal)
Private RAM per idle agent, harness processes only (Pss_Anon)
metrics.note: sum of smaps_rollup Pss_Anon over harness processes / N at the end of the hold

metrics.label: Private RAM per idle agent, terminal share (tmux, Pss_Anon)
metrics.note: Pss_Anon of the private tmux server / N; a GUI terminal costs more (kitty measured at ~29 MiB per window on the same host)

metrics.label: Peak private RAM of tool child processes (whole fleet)
metrics.note: peak Pss_Anon of every process that is neither harness nor terminal (shells, python, cat...), whole fleet

metrics.label: Peak private RAM per agent from launch to the start of the idle hold, harness only (Pss_Anon)
Peak private RAM per agent while all N agents work at once (incl. terminal and tools)
metrics.note: cgroup anon sampled every 0.25 s while all N agents run a 15-step turn (12 x 16 KB reads, a 20 KB report written and re-read, streamed markdown answer) until the last answer has finished streaming (+2 s), max / N; per-role Pss_Anon every 0.5-0.8 s (lower bound for short-lived tool processes)

metrics.label: CPU per agent when all N agents run the same 15-step work turn at once (night runs only)
Median 15-step work-turn time when all N agents work at once (mock model, constant latency)
p90 15-step work-turn time when all N agents work at once
15-step work-turn time inflation vs one agent alone (p50 at N / p50 at N=1)
metrics.note: mock latency is constant, so this is harness-side CPU and scheduling only, not model contention

metrics.label: Peak private RAM per agent while all N agents work at once, terminal processes only (tmux, PTY)
Peak private RAM per agent while all N agents work at once, tool/command processes only
Peak private RAM per agent while all N agents work at once, harness only (Pss_Anon)
Private RAM per agent 60 s after all N agents finished the work turn
Private RAM per agent after resuming a real-size session in the TUI
metrics.note: session grown headless to session_mb (16 KB tool outputs), harness killed, resumed with its own --continue in a tmux TUI; read 30 s after resume

metrics.label: Private RAM per agent after one turn in a resumed real-size session
Private RAM per agent 5 min after a turn in a resumed real-size session
Peak private RAM per agent, resumed real-size session (resume + turn + idle)
Private RAM, one agent idle after 300 tool turns (~1M tokens, default compaction)
metrics.note: one agent; 300 x 16 KB tool outputs; the harness's own default compaction (count in compactions); read after 5 min idle

metrics.label: Peak private RAM during 300 tool turns (~1M tokens, default compaction)
Largest fleet (of 1, 10, 25, 50) where all agents started and finished the work turn at once
Largest fleet that started and survived the hold (tried up to 50)
metrics.note: largest N where all agents finished their first turn and stayed alive through the hold
